name: Balanced
description: Reduces the chance of stumbling or being knocked off balance by a hit stick.

name: Recoup
description: Reduces fatigue buildup and speeds up stamina recovery.

name: Workhorse
description: Reduces the wear-and-tear penalty from heavy usage over a game.

name: Sleight of Hand
description: Improves ball-fake quality on play-action and pump fakes.

name: Step Up
description: Improves throw accuracy when standing in a clean pocket with no pressure.

name: Magician
description: Improves agility for maneuvering around the pocket to avoid pressure.

name: Off Platform
description: Greatly improves accuracy on off-platform throws (across the body or on the back foot) to receivers up to 40 yards downfield.

name: Extender
description: Improves the chance to break free from a sack attempt.

name: Mobile Resistance
description: Improves resistance to pressure while throwing on the run.

name: Resistance
description: Improves resistance to pressure while standing in the pocket.

name: Dot
description: Improves accuracy when throwing to an open receiver with feet set in a clean pocket.

name: Pull Down
description: Improves ball security when sacked or when throwing.

name: Option King
description: Improves speed and throw accuracy on option pitches.

name: Mobile Deadeye
description: Improves accuracy on throws made while on the run outside the pocket.

name: On Time
description: Improves accuracy when throwing before the receiver breaks on their route.

name: Headfirst
description: Improves the chance to break tackles.

name: Arm Bar
description: Improves the effectiveness of the stiff arm move.

name: Human Joystick
description: Reduces the speed lost when cutting.

name: Juke Box
description: Improves the effectiveness of the juke move.

name: Spin Cycle
description: Improves the effectiveness of the spin move.

name: Downhill
description: Improves the chance to break tackles once the ball carrier reaches max speed.

name: Battering Ram
description: Increases fatigue dealt to a defender who is run through on a tackle attempt.

name: Ball Security
description: Improves ball security, reducing fumble chance.
Improves catch chance on contested jump balls thrown more than 10 yards downfield or in the end zone.

name: Safety Valve
description: Improves route running against man coverage and catching when lined up in the backfield.

name: Lay Out
description: Improves the chance to secure diving catches.

name: Sure Hands
description: Reduces drops and prevents the ball from being knocked out on contact.

name: Cutter
description: Improves cut quality on routes run against man coverage.

name: Double Dip
description: Improves the chance to win double-move routes against single man coverage.

name: Press Pro
description: Improves the ability to beat press coverage at the line of scrimmage.

name: Takeoff
description: Improves release speed off the line when not being pressed.

name: Sidekick
description: Improves cut-block effectiveness.

name: Pocket Shield
description: Improves pass blocking inside 10 yards of the first-down marker.

name: Quick Drop
description: Improves pass-block movement on standard dropback pass plays.

name: Option Shield
description: Improves option blocking near the line of scrimmage.

name: Inside Shield
description: Improves run blocking on inside runs near the line of scrimmage.

name: Screen Enforcer
description: Improves blocking on screen plays, including the chance to pancake a defender.

name: PA Shield
description: Improves play-action pass blocking on 1st down or when there are fewer than 3 yards to go.

name: Second Level
description: Improves blocking once the lineman reaches the second level of the defense.

name: Outside Shield
description: Improves first-level run blocking on outside runs.

name: Strong Grip
description: Reduces the chance of being shed laterally on run or pass plays.

name: Ground N Pound
description: Adds fatigue to a defender who gets pancaked on a run play.

name: Wear Down
description: Adds fatigue to a defender who gets pancaked on a pass play.

name: Quick Step
description: Improves movement when pulling as a blocker.

name: Hammer
description: Improves the effectiveness of the hit stick tackle.

name: Take Down
description: Prevents broken tackles during a sack attempt.

name: Knockout
description: Improves the chance to force a fumble on a tackle and prevents broken tackles when breaking up a catch.

name: Duress
description: Generates pressure on the quarterback when unblocked and rushing from in front.

name: Wrap Up
description: Prevents broken tackles and fake-outs (jukes and spins) while tackling.

name: Blow Up
description: Improves the chance to beat an impact (lead) block.

name: Inside Disruptor
description: Improves block shedding against inside runs, including double teams.

name: Outside Disruptor
description: Improves block shedding against outside runs, including double teams.

name: Option Disruptor
description: Improves block shedding against option runs, including double teams.

name: Pocket Disruptor
description: Improves pass-rush block shedding, especially on 3rd and 4th down.

name: Grip Breaker
description: Improves the ability to shed blocks laterally on any play.

name: Aftershock
description: Greatly increases wear-and-tear fatigue dealt to opponents on tackles.

name: Quick Jump
description: Improves timing when jumping the snap count.

name: Bouncer
description: Fatigues receivers and slows their acceleration on zone chucks at the line of scrimmage.

name: Jammer
description: Improves the ability to press receivers at the line of scrimmage.

name: House Call
description: Improves interception chance and stamina during interception returns.

name: Blanket Coverage
description: Improves reaction to route cuts in man coverage.

name: Robber
description: Improves closing speed and movement in man or zone coverage.

name: Ballhawk
description: Improves the break on the ball after a pass is thrown.

name: Deep Range
description: Improves accuracy and timing on field goals of 50+ yards.

name: Mega Leg
description: Removes the penalty for kicking the ball out of the back of the end zone.

name: Coffin Corner
description: Improves punt accuracy when punting from midfield or closer.

name: Field Flip
description: Improves punt timing when punting from the kicking team's own 10-yard line or further back.

name: Chip Shot
description: Improves accuracy and timing on short field goals.

name: Road Dog
description: Increases composure gained while playing on the road.

name: Winning Time
description: Increases composure gained in the final 2 minutes of a game decided by 10 points or less.

name: Fan Favorite
description: Increases composure gained while playing at home.

name: Headstrong
description: Resists failed pre-play adjustments and protects composure from crowd noise.

name: Field General
description: Reveals pre-snap blitzes, coverage shells, and disguised coverages.

name: Clearheaded
description: Protects against composure loss.

name: Clutch Kicker
description: Improves accuracy and timing, and removes icing effects, on field goals in the final 2 minutes.

name: The Natural
description: Removes the effects of bad weather on play.

name: Team Player
description: Removes the rating penalty for playing out of position.

name: Best Friend
description: Increases the QB's composure when this receiver makes a 1st-down catch on 3rd or 4th down.

name: DL Rally
description: Increases a defensive lineman's composure after recording a sack.

name: OL Rally
description: Increases an offensive lineman's composure after a pancake block.

name: Legion
description: Increases a defensive back's composure after an interception or pass breakup.

name: Instinct
description: Improves reaction time to run plays on defense.

name: Adrenaline
description: Speeds up recovery from wear-and-tear fatigue while on the sideline.

name: Rollercoaster
description: Increases the swings, positive and negative, in composure gain and loss.
